title: W1 native gate (T147 steps 1-3b) on the current tree
description: Rebuild folio-base and folio-p2 smoke binaries after T155, run native-gate.py --runs 2 per ui3-p2/NATIVE-GATE-MORNING.md; record numbers. Coordinator runs it.

handoff.text: Reject pending a fresh post-fix native run. The recorded W1 result fails the prescribed caret gate: upFromPage2ToPage1Last=false in both runs (native-gate-results.json; also stated in the T167 done note). NATIVE-GATE-MORNING.md defines every caret flag as required and says a false flag fails the gate. T168 is currently implementing the ArrowUp/Down-across-spacer fix, but it is still in progress; please rerun native-gate.py --runs 2 on the resulting current tree and record all flags before resubmitting T167.

review.note: Approved: the post-T168 native gate in ui3-p2/w2-gate.log and native-gate-results.json contains four interleaved base/p2 probes, with both p2 runs ok. Required caret flags are 6/6 true in each p2 run; sync latency p50/p95 meet the gate budget; narrow 585 px pane drift is 1 px and refPageMismatches is 0. Paint p95 exceeds 50 ms, but the T167 note reports this to the owner as required; native follow-up scope is documented. Evidence is timestamped after the final T168 tree.

log.note: Native gate on WebKit (2 interleaved runs, logs ui3-p2/w1-gate.log, native-gate-results.json): p2 sync p50 9 / p95 10-15 ms (budget 25/50) PASS; paint ratio p2/base <=1.24 PASS; 585 pane zoom 0.678, maxPageStartDrift 0, refPageMismatches 0 PASS.
